@deskConTitle.description: Title of the Contacts page: saved people and shops with their addresses.

@deskConLoading.description: Line with a spinner on Contacts while the list loads.

@deskConNewTitle.description: Title of the form for a new contact (page title on a narrow window, panel title and form heading).

@deskConEditTitle.description: Title of the form for editing a contact (page title on a narrow window, panel title and form heading).

@deskConDetailsTitle.description: Title of the panel beside the contact list when a contact is shown.

@deskConSearchHint.description: Placeholder of the search field above the contact list.

@deskConSearchLabel.description: Screen reader label of the search field above the contact list.

@deskConClearSearch.description: Tooltip of the button that empties the contact search; also the button of the 'no contacts match' state.

@deskConCount.description: Number of saved contacts, above a long contact list.

@deskConNoMatches.description: Count line above the contact list when the search finds nobody.

@deskConMatches.description: Count line above the contact list while searching.

@deskConSortName.description: Option of the sort switch above the contact list: sort by name. Narrow segment.

@deskConSortRecent.description: Option of the sort switch above the contact list: most recently used first. Narrow segment.

@deskConNone.description: Line in the contact list when there are no contacts.

@deskConNoMatchList.description: Line in the contact list when the search finds nobody.

@deskConAdd.description: Button on Contacts that opens the form for a new contact. Short.

@deskConIdle.description: Text in the empty detail panel beside the contact list.

@deskConEmptyTitle.description: Title of the empty state of Contacts.

deskConEmptyText: A contact is a name for an address.

@deskConEmptyText.description: Text of the empty state of Contacts.

@deskConSendToAddress.description: Ghost button in the empty state of Contacts: opens Send without a contact.

@deskConLastTx.description: Small line under a contact's name. The placeholder is a time such as 'today', '3 days ago' or '12 Oct'.

@deskConSend.description: Primary button in a contact's detail: send to this contact. Short.

@deskConEdit.description: Button in a contact's detail: edit it. Short.

@deskConStar.description: Button in a contact's detail: mark as favourite. Short.

@deskConUnstar.description: Button in a contact's detail: remove the favourite mark. Short.

@deskConDelete.description: Danger button in a contact's detail: delete it. Short.

@deskConNotDeleted.description: Title of the toast when a contact could not be deleted; the reason follows as its text.

@deskConDeleted.description: Toast after a contact was deleted.

@deskConNote.description: Label above the note in a contact's detail; also the label of the note field in the form.

@deskConTxWith.description: Heading above the list of payments with this contact.

@deskConAllTx.description: Link next to the heading: opens Activity.

deskConTxNone: No payments with this contact yet. Payments sent to them from Send appear here.

@deskConTxNone.description: Text under the heading when there are no payments with this contact.

@deskConTxReceived.description: Title of a compact row in a contact's payments: an incoming payment. One word.

@deskConTxSent.description: Title of a compact row in a contact's payments: an outgoing payment. One word.

@deskConErrName.description: Error under the Name field of the contact form when it is empty.

@deskConErrAddressEmpty.description: Error under the Address field of the contact form when it is empty.

deskConErrAddressInvalid: Not a valid address. Use an Epicbox address (es5x…@server), a Link address (https://…) or an onion address (….onion).

@deskConErrAddressInvalid.description: Error under the Address field of the contact form when the text is not an address.

@deskConAddPicture.description: Small button in the contact form: add a picture. Only shown when contact pictures exist.

@deskConChangePicture.description: Small button in the contact form: change the picture.

@deskConRemovePicture.description: Small button in the contact form: remove the picture.

deskConPictureHelp: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to 10 MB. A small copy is kept in this app.

@deskConPictureHelp.description: Small text under the picture buttons in the contact form.

@deskConFieldName.description: Label of the Name field in the contact form.

@deskConFieldAddress.description: Label of the Address field in the contact form.

@deskConSaveFailed.description: Title of the red notice in the contact form when saving failed; the reason follows.

@deskConSave.description: Primary button of the contact form. Short.

@deskConDeleteTitle.description: Title of the dialog that asks before deleting a contact.

deskConDeleteBody: Removes the contact; past payments stay in Activity. This cannot be undone.

@deskConDeleteBody.description: Body of the dialog that asks before deleting a contact.

@deskConKeep.description: Button in the delete dialog: do not delete. Short.

@deskConDeleteAction.description: Danger button in the delete dialog. Short.

deskConPickForPairing: The pairing is added to the contact you choose.

@deskConPickForPairing.description: Subtitle of the Choose contact dialog when it picks the contact a pairing is added to (Add to a contact), not a Send recipient.

@deskConExportDo.description: Primary button of the Export contacts dialog: goes on to the system Save dialog.
